headline: Mindspace REIT Reports Q2 FY27 Results with Record DPU and High Occupancy
summary: Mindspace REIT posted its Q2 FY27 financial results, highlighting a record distribution per unit (DPU) and 96% occupancy.
why: Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) distribute a high percentage of their income, making DPU and occupancy rates key metrics for income-focused investors.

impacts.name: Mindspace Business Parks REIT
impacts.why: The REIT reported record DPU and high occupancy in its quarterly earnings update.
